simling: Simulated Linguistic Data for Teaching and Learning Statistics

Source: R/simling-package.R
simling-package.Rd

Simulated data sets from many branches of linguistics. Each help page lists the variables and the true model the data were simulated from; the code is in data-raw/ on GitHub. simling_datasets() lists them all, with their branch, language, size, response and topic.

Details

Every categorical column is a factor. Its first level is the reference level: the baseline condition, the first group or the expected response. IDs such as participants, speakers and words are factors too. Binary outcomes coded 0/1 and rating scales are numeric. The exception is messy_export, which keeps the text columns of a raw export.
